preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 50000 inclusive.
For each test case, the number of sets n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= k_i <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('t') and not line.strip().startswith('n'))
preconditions.description: Each set has between 2 and 10^5 elements (k_i).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('t') and not line.strip().startswith('n') and not line.strip().startswith('k'))
preconditions.description: All elements in each set are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(map(int, line.split()[1:])))) == len(line.split()[1:]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('t') and not line.strip().startswith('n'))
preconditions.description: All elements in each set are distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.strip().count(' ') == 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output is either '-1' (no similar sets) or two distinct integers (1-based indices of similar sets).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and any(len(set(s1) & set(s2)) >= 2 for s1, s2 in zip(sets, sets[1:])) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the two sets at the given indices share at least two common elements.
